title: Global Dietary Magnesium Deficiency: Prevalence, Underlying Causes, Health Consequences, and Strategic Solutions
container: International Journal for Vitamin and Nutrition Research
note: A relay for the 2.4 billion figure, whose primary source is Passarelli et al. (2024). One author, Youyou Zhao, is affiliated with Sirio Pharma, a supplement manufacturer. The figure counts people below recommended intake, not people with a measured body deficit.

excerpts.anchor: Global perspective: A 2024 modeling study that estimated median intakes
marks: 2.4 billion people or approximately 31% of the global population had inadequate magnesium intake
